5.label: Numbers and judgement
5.text: Numbers should inform decision-making while judgement stays in charge. A dashboard can show strength while the heart of the system is drifting. Use this with “A management system converts reports into movement”.

7.label: F · Foster a Results Culture
7.text: Culture is revealed through the way work is assigned, recognised and maintained. When only highly visible work is rewarded, essential support functions disengage. People need to know their contribution matters even when senior leaders do not see it.

9.label: Accurate ratings
9.text: The most meaningful feedback is the most accurate. Leaders who inflate assessments to avoid discomfort deprive people of the truth they need to grow. Use this with 3 · Meets Expectations as SOLID GOLD.

9.label: Discretionary effort
9.text: Reviews usually account for results, milestones and behaviours, and rarely for who showed up when the work got hard. Add one question to the review: when the last difficult initiative needed discretionary effort, who came and who stayed away?

11.label: Bridge 1 · Decomposing the Big Picture
11.text: Large efforts succeed when the work is organised into manageable sections with clear ownership, after a disciplined assessment of the true starting condition.

13.label: Step 1 · Prepare the Foundation
13.text: Strategy becomes executable when decision rights, boundaries and accountability are defined before the pressure arrives. Set the standards explicitly, and name the seriousness of a situation honestly when it comes.

14.label: Accountability at the top
14.text: A culture that holds everyone accountable except the most powerful runs on performance for junior people and immunity for senior ones. No role is above the standards the culture requires.

14.label: The leader’s evidence
14.text: The condition of the organisation, the experience of its people and the consistency of its operations reveal whether leadership capability has been translated into practice. Use this with “Cumulative outcome trajectory”.

16.label: Same data, same truth
16.text: A system loses reliability when people say what authority wants to hear. Capability without alignment can still produce poor collective outcomes.

18.label: Gap 3 · Incentive Misalignment
18.text: Cultures that take the value people produce without returning it equitably erode the motivation that produced it. People stop caring about the harvest when they know they will not share in it.

18.label: What the system rewards
18.text: When an organisation visibly rewards self-promotion, people spend their energy positioning and the quiet contributor is overlooked. Raise the people who did the work without angling for the credit, so that contribution becomes the path upward.

23.label: C · Collective Ownership
23.text: Organisations flourish when responsibility is shared, every unit contributes to the common purpose and dependence on a few individuals falls away.
